title: Context pipeline promotion-blocker closure and adversarial completion protocol
objective: Close the five independently reproduced promotion blockers left by M0-T075 (D-018) without a rebuild: (A) repair SingleWriterLock so ownership metadata is complete before the public lock is visible, every owner holds an unguessable token, stale takeover is atomic move/quarantine, partial metadata never reclaims a live lock, release is token-matched, and load->conflict->mutation->validation->promotion->retention stay in one ownership span, with the exact publication-race regression; (B) route every context read (incl. --ci-summary) through the shared containment rule, redact caller-supplied absolute paths, and make a refused explicit --include/--ci-summary insufficient/nonzero with no marker leakage; (C) resolve+validate a frozen G0 diff base for worker/reviewer packets with committed-work tests; (D) consume the real Unit E view primitive and apply the deterministic changed-code-first seed order with recorded selection; (E) honest routing unknowns raising ambiguity; (F) useful bounded advisory memory digests; (G) a reproducible clean-checkout e2e benchmark in permanent CI. Plus an honest M0-T075 reconciliation report; no reopening of accepted records.
business_reason: D-019 owner corrective directive: make D-013-R060 promotion honestly decidable by closing the reproduced blockers; leave R060 pending for the owner.
inputs: Accepted M0-T075 (D-018) context pipeline on main 3c10894 - integrated, NOT rebuilt or reopened

Five independently reproduced promotion blockers (handoff section 4 + this session's pre-change failure records): A lock publication/reclaim race, B --ci-summary/--include containment bypass + private-path echo, C dirty-capture e2e baseline, D diff-base HEAD reviewer failure, E incomplete Unit E consumption / alphabetical seed cap / silent-false routing / thin advisory memory
tools/model_routing.py Signals + classify() (consumed READ-ONLY; not modified)
tools/repo_views.py accepted Unit E view builders (the real primitive to consume)
outputs: tools/repo_index_cache.py - SingleWriterLock reworked: fully-populated temp dir with owner metadata + unguessable token atomically renamed into place; stale takeover via atomic move to quarantine; partial/missing metadata never reclaims a live lock; token-matched release; one ownership span for load->conflict->mutation->validation->promotion->retention
tools/memory_graph.py - promotion transaction uses the token-checked lock; two-writer publication-race regression proves no lost node

tools/context_paths.py + tools/context_pack_sources.py - ALL context reads (incl. --ci-summary) routed through the shared containment rule; caller-supplied absolute strings redacted in every omission/error detail; a refused explicit --include/--ci-summary makes the packet insufficient (nonzero) with no marker leakage to context.md/meta/evidence/stdout/stderr

tools/context_pack_index.py + tools/repo_views.py - the compiler consumes a genuine shared Unit E neighborhood primitive (traced call path); deterministic changed-code-first seed order with all selected/unresolved/skipped-over-cap candidates recorded; no duplicate source/test excerpts

tools/context_pack_evidence.py - bounded advisory memory digests carry useful fields (digest id, outcome+agent, bounded note, requirement ids, file paths, evidence refs, unresolved/quarantined state, source/repo identity), explicitly advisory, under the single global budget

tools/context_benchmark.py + .github/workflows/ci.yml - frozen apples-to-apples e2e benchmark (equivalent packet/diff base/role/provider-model/reasoning/source snapshot/clean state) that exits 0 twice from independent clean checkouts and is added to permanent CI; no-worse-than-baseline tests required evidence + relevance, not only source-ID counts; provider token savings UNMEASURED
project-control/reports/M0-T076-baseline-g0.json - clean-state frozen baseline (new; M0-T075's baseline is preserved unmodified)

project-control/reports/M0-T075-reconciliation-correction.md - honest record of what the M0-T075 e2e 'no-worse' result actually demonstrated (dirty-state capture), analogous to the M0-T069 scope correction; no reopening of accepted records
project-control/reports/M0-T076-* producer evidence (producer report, counterexample matrix, evidence map, coverage evidence, e2e benchmark report, G0 readiness)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the former two-promoted/one-lost concurrent memory-writer schedule (writer A pauses during lock publication, writer B enters)
acceptance_scenarios.when: both promotions run against the reworked SingleWriterLock
acceptance_scenarios.then: ownership metadata + an unguessable token are visible atomically before the lock is public; B cannot reclaim A's live lock from missing/partial metadata; either both nodes survive or exactly one gets concurrent_writer and succeeds on retry; both-promoted-with-one-node-lost is impossible; the exact deterministic publication-race regression exists (D-019-R015..R021)

acceptance_scenarios.given: absolute/drive/traversal/dot/doubled-separator/backslash/escaping-link paths presented to --include, --ci-summary, and every other context read (task/state/directive requirements, routing table, checkpoint/blocker/handoff, source/test/contract excerpts, graph/view seeds, ontology inputs, deep views, memory evidence)
acceptance_scenarios.when: each read is attempted (static and raced escaping-link)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the shared containment rule refuses each; no absolute path is read or echoed in context.md/metadata/evidence/stdout/stderr; a refused explicitly requested --include/--ci-summary makes the packet insufficient and the exit nonzero (D-019-R022..R025)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a task whose work has been COMMITTED on its branch
acceptance_scenarios.when: the canonical orchestrator prepares worker and reviewer packets
acceptance_scenarios.then: it resolves+validates the task's frozen G0 base (never silently HEAD), the committed hunks are present, the packet exits 0, and the chosen base SHA/resolution/head SHA/dirty-clean state/exact diff command are recorded; committed-work tests cover both committed and uncommitted states (D-019-R026..R028)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the M0-T066 clean compile and the shared Unit E primitive
acceptance_scenarios.then: the compiler consumes the genuine shared Unit E view primitive (traced import + call), M0-T066's subsystem implementation files are queried before documentation/control-plane candidates consume the five-seed cap, the deterministic seed order records all selected/unresolved/skipped-over-cap candidates, and source/test excerpts are not duplicated (D-019-R029..R031)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a concurrency-focused task and any task whose risk-bearing impact is not structurally determinable
acceptance_scenarios.when: model_routing.Signals are derived from the compiled evidence
acceptance_scenarios.then: every field is derived from authoritative structured compiled evidence or identified as undetermined; an undetermined risk-bearing signal (concurrency/security/schema/destructive/external-side-effect/protected-config) raises ambiguity_or_missing_evidence; a concurrency task can never emerge as concurrency_or_performance=false with no ambiguity; protected model configuration is unchanged (D-019-R032..R033)

acceptance_scenarios.then: the deterministic input-manifest digest still marks it STALE with nonzero exit (no regression from M0-T075) (D-019-R014 proof 9)

it remains byte-identical across every case and the pre-existing context/index/graph/memory/view/benchmark/projection/routing suites remain green; no existing test removed/skipped/weakened (D-019-R011, R014 proofs 11-12)
